column1: # Phase 3 milestone G follow-up: the scheduled block-tick loop's interaction trace
# NOT a vanilla dump (see block_tick_meta.tsv): every row is one thing the loop,
# a rule or the caller did, in order, with the tick it happened in. `action` is
# the caller's scripted work (see block_tick_actions.tsv); `due` is the drain —
# one row per position, in the canonical order the region path dispatches them
# (the queue's own order is the hash map's and is deliberately not pinned; see the
# tool's header); `state` closes each tick with the queue's own clock, pending
# count and non-empty chunk count; `schedule` is `Level.scheduleTick` with the
# delay the block asked for and the due tick that follows from it; `read`,
# `sturdy` and `light` are the world questions the rules ask (a fire's spread
# walks a 3 x 3 x 5 box, which is most of what these rows are); `write` is a
# block write with vanilla's client flag — the age-only write is the one with
# `false`, which is also why it notifies no neighbour; `drop` is a due position
# the dispatch refused (the block that scheduled it is gone); `item`/`prime` are
# the two hooks the scheduled path can reach; `draw i`/`draw u` are the recorded
